entries.title: Compress
entries.summary: An offline image compressor with a before/after slider, batch queue and per-file savings. No account, no uploads, no network calls.
entries.built: The whole app: picker flow, preview pipeline, encoder retry loop, queue management, sharing, launcher icon and the settings screen.

entries.title: Icons app and browser
entries.summary: All 4,373 glyphs from four free brands with a live preview, variant controls and the set folded into a scrolling sheet; the same page ships as an offline Android app.
entries.built: The fetch pipeline, the generated brand pages, the preview and variant logic, the collapsible set, the WebView wrapper that serves the bundle from a private origin, and the catalogs both read.
entries.stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Java WebView, Python fetch script

entries.title: This site
entries.summary: The shelf: catalogs for the tools, icons, fonts and work, all built from the same measurements as the app and all readable as JSON.
entries.built: The measured layout, one shared stylesheet, the JSON builder that re-measures every shipped file, and the render gallery.
entries.stack: Hand-written HTML and CSS, Python build steps, static hosting
